seoTitle: Bridgerton Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Bridgerton test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Daphne, Anthony, Kate, Colin, Penelope, Eloise, Benedict or Lady Danbury. Get your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the one quietly noticing everything from the edge of the ballroom, the one who refuses to play by society's rules, or the one holding the whole family together? Answer 12 everyday questions about love, family and gossip, and find out which Bridgerton character you are.

characters.name: Daphne Bridgerton
characters.title: The Diamond
characters.summary: Gracious, warm and quietly determined. You know exactly what you want, a real love and a family, and you won't settle for less.
description: Like Daphne, you know how to handle a room. She was declared the diamond of the season by the Queen herself, and she carried it off beautifully.
You're smarter than people expect. When the pressure to marry got too much, Daphne came up with a plan: a fake courtship with the Duke of Hastings to make herself more wanted.
But you want the real thing. Daphne wanted a true love match and a family of her own, and she fought for both.
characters.flaw: You try so hard to do the right thing that you forget to ask what you actually want.
characters.signature: A perfect curtsey, a ballroom full of admirers and a secret plan.
characters.clashReason: they'd always be the one everyone looks at

characters.name: Anthony Bridgerton
characters.title: The Dutiful Head of the Family
characters.summary: Responsible, intense and very competitive. You carry everyone's future on your shoulders, and you hate losing at anything.
description: Like Anthony, you became the grown-up far too early. He was a young man when his father died suddenly from a bee sting, right in front of him, and he became head of the family overnight.
You put duty first. Anthony was determined to choose a wife sensibly, with his head and not his heart, because love meant you had something to lose.
You're very, very competitive. Nobody in the family takes a game of pall-mall more seriously, especially when Kate Sharma is playing.
characters.flaw: You try to control everything, because you're scared of losing anything.
characters.signature: A furrowed brow, a family ledger and a mallet he refuses to put down.
characters.clashReason: they'd try to run your life for your own good

characters.name: Kate Sharma
characters.title: The Fierce Protector
characters.summary: Blunt, brave and fiercely protective. You say what you think, and you put the people you love before yourself.
description: Like Kate, you don't hold back. She arrived in London determined to find her younger sister Edwina the perfect husband, and she wasn't afraid to tell a viscount exactly what she thought of him.
You put your family first, every time. Kate sacrificed her own happiness again and again for the people she loves.
You're competitive and a little bit wild. Kate rides fast, plays to win and matched Anthony at every turn.
characters.flaw: You're so busy protecting others that you never let yourself have what you want.
characters.signature: A fast horse, a sharp comeback and a winning shot at pall-mall.
characters.clashReason: they'd argue with every word you said

characters.name: Colin Bridgerton
characters.title: The Charming Adventurer
characters.summary: Warm, funny and restless. You're great company, and you're still working out who you really want to be.
description: Like Colin, you're easy to like. He's the charming, easy-going Bridgerton brother who can make anyone laugh.
You want more than the life that's been planned for you. Colin travels abroad looking for adventure and a sense of purpose, and comes back a changed man.
Sometimes you miss what's right in front of you. Colin took years to realise that his friend Penelope Featherington was the one.
characters.flaw: You're still working out who you are, and sometimes you try on the wrong version.
characters.signature: A tan from somewhere far away, a travel journal and a warm grin.
characters.clashReason: they'd take years to notice you

characters.name: Penelope Featherington
characters.title: The Secret Writer
characters.summary: Observant, clever and underestimated. People overlook you, which is exactly what lets you see everything.
description: Like Penelope, you notice everything. She spent years as a wallflower at the edge of the ballroom, watching and listening while nobody paid her any attention.
You have a secret life. Penelope is Lady Whistledown, the anonymous writer whose gossip sheet has the whole of London talking.
You love quietly and for a long time. Penelope was in love with Colin Bridgerton for years before he finally noticed.
characters.flaw: You'd rather hide behind a secret than risk being seen.
characters.signature: A quill, a very bright gown and a room full of people who have no idea.
characters.clashReason: they know far more about you than you think

characters.name: Eloise Bridgerton
characters.title: The Rebel
characters.summary: Sharp, bookish and outspoken. You refuse to follow rules that make no sense, and you'll say so at length.
description: Like Eloise, you've got no interest in doing what's expected. She finds the marriage market ridiculous, and she makes sure everyone knows it.
You'd rather read, debate and think. Eloise is curious about everything, and she's happiest with a book or a big idea.
You're a loyal friend, until you feel betrayed. Eloise was Penelope's closest friend, and finding out Penelope's secret hit her hard.
characters.flaw: You're so busy being against things that you forget what you're for.
characters.signature: A book under her arm, a secret cigarette and a speech about the marriage market.
characters.clashReason: they'd lecture you about everything you believe

characters.name: Benedict Bridgerton
characters.title: The Free Spirit
characters.summary: Artistic, fun-loving and open to anything. You follow your heart, and you're in no hurry to settle down.
description: Like Benedict, you're the creative one. He's a talented artist who won a place at the Royal Academy Schools.
You care about earning things yourself. When Benedict found out Anthony had paid to get him in, he walked away from art school.
You're in no rush. Benedict loves a party, an adventure and meeting interesting people, and he'd rather follow his heart than a plan.
characters.flaw: You drift from one thing to the next without committing to any of it.
characters.signature: A sketchbook, a bohemian party and a mysterious woman in silver at a masquerade.
characters.clashReason: they'd never commit to anything, including plans with you

characters.name: Lady Danbury
characters.title: The Grande Dame
characters.summary: Wise, formidable and razor-sharp. You've seen it all, you fear no one and you give the best advice in the room.
description: Like Lady Danbury, you're formidable. She's one of the most respected, and feared, women in London society, and she never loses an argument.
You look after people who need it. Lady Danbury took in a young Simon after his father rejected him, and became his mentor.
You speak your mind with style. Lady Danbury's cutting one-liners are legendary, and her cane makes every point a little sharper.
characters.flaw: You can't resist telling people exactly what they should do.
characters.signature: A cane, a raised eyebrow and a devastating one-liner.
characters.clashReason: they'd see straight through your excuses

questions.text: You arrive at a fancy party where you barely know anyone. You...

options.text: Stand near the wall and quietly notice everything
Charm the whole room within ten minutes
Head straight for the most interesting-looking people
Take a good seat. People will come to you

questions.text: Your family keeps hinting that it's time you settled down. You...

options.text: Absolutely not. You have plans of your own
Welcome it. You've always wanted a family of your own
Laugh it off. You're too busy enjoying life
Agree it's your duty, and look for someone sensible

questions.text: Someone you love is about to make a big mistake. You...

options.text: Tell them straight, even if they hate you for it
Step in and fix it for them
Say one wise thing and let them work it out
Talk to them gently and try to understand why
Sketch or paint in the garden
Get outside and do something that gets your heart racing
Read something scandalous, and enjoy every page
Plan your next trip abroad

questions.text: People keep assuming you're the quiet, harmless one. You...

options.text: Let them. Being overlooked is the perfect cover
Prove them wrong, loudly
Give them a lecture they won't forget
Stay gracious, and quietly outplay them

questions.text: Your friends start a competitive game at a get-together. You...

options.text: Play to win. Always
Pick the one person you most want to beat
Make everyone laugh so much they forget the score
Sit it out and heckle from the sofa

questions.text: If someone read your notebook, they'd find...

options.text: Stories and notes from places you've travelled
Sharp observations about everyone you know
Big ideas about how the world should change
Sketches, not words

questions.text: A friend becomes the talk of the town for something embarrassing. You...

options.text: Tell the gossips to find a better hobby
Feel awful. You know exactly how fast gossip spreads
Defend them loudly to anyone who'll listen
Deal with it quietly before it damages the family's name

questions.text: When it comes to love, you...

options.text: Avoid it. Love just means you have something to lose
Have quietly loved the same person for years
Want a true love match and nothing less
Fall for someone mysterious you can't stop thinking about

questions.text: Someone gives you advice you didn't ask for. You...

options.text: Listen politely, then do exactly what you were going to do
Argue with every word of it
Take it to heart. You're still figuring yourself out
Nod, then go and do something far more fun

questions.text: You live in 1800s high society. An anonymous writer is publishing gossip about everyone, including your family. You...

options.text: Make it your mission to unmask them
Protect your family's name, whatever it takes
Read every issue. Gossip is information
Quietly admire how well it is written

questions.text: You live in 1800s London. Your family expects you to marry someone rich you don't love, to save its fortunes. You...

options.text: Meet them, then come up with a clever plan to get out of it
Agree, if it keeps the people you love safe
Run. You'd rather be poor and free
Secretly find a way to earn your own money
